own_solution.law: Grating equation d sin(theta) = m lambda at normal incidence; separation = asin(2*650/4000) - asin(2*450/4000)
assumptions: angles measured from the grating normal

defect_reasons.other: The screen sentences refer to 'the screen' although no screen is introduced in the problem; harmless since the angular separation does not depend on the screen distance.

notes: Base: theta(450)=asin(0.225)=13.003 deg, theta(650)=asin(0.325)=18.966 deg, separation 5.963 deg. With 560 nm replacing 450 nm: asin(0.28)=16.260 deg, separation 2.705 deg. Earlier-measurement sentences (T30F6 with 560 nm, T9433 with no number) do not apply to the asked measurement; second-spectrometer sentences are disconnected. T9433 and T8CA3 state no number, so they cannot be numeric variants of the 560 nm sentences; T19FA/T30F6/TD8FB/TFEEC share 560 nm. Screen distance enters only the linear positions y = L tan(theta), not the angles, hence C.
